alternatives.name: VENUE_NATIVE_INSTRUMENT_IDENTITY
tradeoffs: Prevents collapse of venue-specific crypto markets into fictional universal prices.

negative: Higher identity complexity than single-tape equities.

decision.summary: Crypto instruments bind asset class, base/quote assets, venue/upstream source, and contract specification. Provider symbols are source metadata. Multiple venue prices for the same logical pair are not automatically errors.
decision.title: Crypto instrument and venue identity

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Proposed status records intent only. It does not authorize adapters, ingestion, providers, brokers, simulation extensions, or trading.
